result_text:
The "past 90d" block now shows the 90-day main LOC instead of the 180-day figure.

The bug was in `addActiveRepositoriesInfoBlocks` in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`. The block's LOC text used `loc180Days`, while its count and percentage used the 90-day values. I changed that one reference to `loc90Days`, so the LOC matches the count and percentage.

`mvn -q -o -pl reports test` finished with no output, which in quiet mode means it passed. I didn't run a specific test or render the Overview tab, so the example (500 vs 2.5K LOC) is verified by reading the code, not by running the report. Nothing was committed.
